problem: Fresh exact-preview cross-browser evidence still showed transient preview 404s, stale header interaction selectors and tablet CLS on ai-modelwijzer.
root_cause: The PR workflow considered the preview ready when only / returned 200; the assurance contract still targeted legacy-only navigation controls; the shared tablet trustbar container did not reserve its complete final height before runtime stabilization.
decision: Require exact preview sitemap and representative generated routes before the sweep, support both canonical shared-header and legacy V18 controls, correct canonical aria-controls, and reserve fixed tablet trustbar geometry.
prevention: Never use the production sitemap to test an incompletely built pull-request preview.
Browser interaction contracts must follow canonical semantic controls and keep legacy compatibility only where generated pages still use V18.
Tablet trustbar outer and inner geometry is reserved before runtime so downstream content cannot jump.
